flash_695889.description:
Noam LeIsrael party chairman MK Avi Maoz responded to a Kan 11 News report claiming that Bezalel Smotrich has been holding discreet talks with his party regarding its possible withdrawal from the Knesset race.

"Contrary to the false reports, Noam LeIsrael has not held and is not holding any negotiations with any party in the political arena. We intend to stay in the race until the very end, until our great victory, with God's help," a statement on behalf of Maoz said.

flash_695926.description:
Judea and Samaria District Police Commander Chief Superintendent Moshe Pinchi conducted a situational assessment following the attack this morning (Friday) at the Yehuda Junction and ordered increased activity on the roads, including checking vehicles and suspects and seizing vehicles that were taken off the road.

The investigation of the attack was assigned to the minority faction in the Judea and Samaria Intelligence Directorate, which will assist the Shin Bet in the investigation.

flash_695924.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee reacted to the shooting attack near Hebron and called on the media to provide the same level of coverage for the attack that they gave to other stories.

"The Palestinian terror attack this morning would have been an even worse catastrophic event had the IDF not acted so quickly. Will the media give this as much coverage as when olive pickers get detained for failing to report their activities?" Huckabee wrote on X.

flash_695922.description: Azam Khan was arrested after allegedly attempting to smash the doors of the Young Israel synagogue with a club and setting fire to a yard sign in an effort to ignite the building.

flash_695920.description: Why accomplishments and a realistic understanding of political power must be the main factors behind the votes of Israel’s identity-politicized Religious Zionists. Opinion.

flash_695918.description: A soldier who participated in the exchange of fire with the terrorists at Yehuda Junction described the moments of the encounter, the bullet that struck his helmet, and his attempt to calm a fellow soldier.

flash_695915.description:
The head of the Binyamin Council and the chairman of the Yesha Council, Yisrael Ganz, made his way to the scene of the attack at Yehuda Junction. Ganz prayed for the recovery of the wounded and praised the security forces who eliminated the terrorists. He said that thousands of weapons are in the hands of terrorists in Judea and Samaria, and in the last thirty days, 197 terrorist incidents and attacks have been recorded in the area.

Ganz warned against a repeat of the events of October 7: "This is not a lone terrorist or an isolatedattack, but a broad threat that is growing and could end in a major disaster." He said, "To prevent another October 7, the State of Israel must dismantle the Palestinian Authority and regain full control of the territory until terrorism is eliminated."

flash_695946.description:
The IDF will hold a large-scale military exercise in northern and central Israel this coming Sunday and Monday, involving the Israeli Air Force and forces from the Northern and Central Commands.

The exercise will simulate scenarios including a surprise attack, infiltration into Israeli territory by air and land, and escalation across multiple fronts simultaneously.

Increased movement of security forces and aircraft is expected over the two days. The IDF stressed that the exercise is planned in advance and that there is no concern about an actual security incident.

You must respect them enough to give them their space. . They have a funny way of showing their love during certain stages of their lives, but they always need it from us.

flash_695927.description:
IDF and Border Police forces are currently conducting counterterrorism operations in the city of Hebron and surrounding villages as part of an offensive operation involving the Duvdevan Unit, the Paratroopers Brigade, the Search and Rescue Brigade, and the Judea and Samaria Border Police.

A full closure has been imposed on the cities of Hebron and Halhul, and dozens of roadblocks have been established throughout the area. The forces are preparing to expand their offensive operations. Meanwhile, the Maglan Unit has been deployed to reinforce counterterrorism and defensive operations in the Judea Regional Brigade's sector, and land-clearing operations have begun to demolish illegal infrastructure at the site of the terrorist attack.

The operation is being conducted under the command of the Judea Regional Brigade commander, in coordination with the Judea and Samaria Border Police, the Civil Administration, and the Israel Police's Judea and Samaria District.

The forces have begun conducting precise, targeted and thorough searches throughout the area to locate and dismantle terrorist infrastructure and weapons, while questioning suspects.
